caption: uranus turns direct today at 1.7° gemini. it only looked like it was going backwards.

slides.headline: *gemini*, *uranus* turns direct in your sign at *7:23 am* today
*uranus* pauses, then moves forward again
slides.body: from earth, uranus has looked like it was drifting backwards for months. today it turns direct. astrologers read uranus as change you didn't plan.

slides.headline: you can want *change* and still pick a person
